missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Подъезд' is a masculine noun in the nominative case as the subject. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'чистый' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Подъезд' is the accusative direct object of 'открыл'. As an inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative, while 'ключом' is the instrumental of means.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'возле'. 'Подъезда' is the genitive form after 'возле' to express location near something. 'Машина' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'.
Strategic focus: Dative with 'к'. 'Подъезду' is the dative form after 'к', expressing motion toward the entrance. 'Вечером' is an instrumental adverb of time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with 'перед'. 'Подъездом' is the instrumental form after 'перед' meaning in front of. 'Дерево' is the nominative subject, and 'большое' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В подъезде' uses the prepositional form 'подъезде' after 'в' to mark location inside. 'Свет' is the nominative subject of 'горит'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Подъезд' is accusative after 'в' to show motion into a place. 'Наш' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'сосед' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. After 'шесть' the noun takes the genitive plural 'подъездов'. 'В доме' is the prepositional location of the count.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Подъезды' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' agrees in the plural, and 'закрыты' is the short participle agreeing in number.
Strategic focus: Genitive with 'из'. 'Подъезда' is the genitive form after 'из', expressing motion out of the entrance. 'Два соседа' uses the genitive singular after the numeral.
